ECB Staff Seek Clarity on Lagarde's Potential Early Exit

Staff at the European Central Bank (ECB) have formally requested clarity regarding potential rumors of European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde's early departure. The staff's concerns reportedly center on the stability of the institution. The specific nature of these concerns and the ECB's response have not been detailed in the provided coverage.
